hero.headline: Safe, certified electrical work for London homes and small businesses.
hero.sub: Fuse boxes, safety reports, rewires and emergency call-outs. Fixed written quotes, tidy work, and a certificate when we finish.

services.title: Fuse boxes and consumer units
services.summary: Replace an old fuse box with a modern, RCD-protected consumer unit.
services.intro: An old fuse box can be unsafe and may not meet current requirements. We replace consumer units in a day, test every circuit, and give you the paperwork your landlord, insurer or buyer will ask for.
points: Survey and fixed written quote before any work starts
Modern consumer unit with RCD protection and surge protection where required
Certificate issued, and building control notified where the work requires it
services.note: Most homes take a single working day. We tell you in advance when the power will be off.

services.title: Electrical safety reports (EICR)
services.summary: A full inspection of your wiring, with a clear report in plain English.
services.intro: Landlords need one on a regular schedule. Buyers and homeowners often want one for peace of mind. We inspect and test your installation and explain every finding.
points: Inspection and testing of the whole installation
A clear outcome: satisfactory or unsatisfactory, with any observations explained
Priced per property size, quoted before we visit
Remedial work quoted separately so you can compare
services.note: Reports are normally ready within two working days of the visit.

services.title: Rewiring and new circuits
services.summary: Full or partial rewires, new sockets, lighting and dedicated circuits.
services.intro: Whether it is a full rewire before decorating, an extra circuit for a kitchen, or a charger point for an electric car, we plan the work around you and leave the property clean.
points: Planned around your decorating and building schedule
Dust sheets and a clean-up every day
Certificate and building control notification where required
services.note: We quote from a survey, not a guess, and we stick to the quote unless you ask for changes.

services.title: Emergency call-outs
services.summary: Power loss, tripping circuits, burning smells and storm damage.
services.intro: If you smell burning, see scorch marks or have lost power, switch off at the consumer unit if it is safe to do so and call us. For fire or immediate danger, call 999 first.
points: We make the problem safe first, then explain the options
Clear call-out price given on the phone
services.note: Call us rather than using the enquiry form for anything urgent.

process.title: Tell us what you need
process.text: Call or send the form below. We reply within one working day.

process.title: We survey and quote
process.text: A short visit, then a fixed written quote with no hidden extras.

process.title: We do the work
process.text: Booked at a time that suits you, with the power off only when needed.

process.title: You get the paperwork
process.text: Certificates and test results, and a final check that you are happy.
